policies.base module¶

Base Policy Definitions for NGLab.

Defines the abstract interface for all trading policies, ensuring consistency between heuristic and neural approaches.

policies.black_scholes module¶

Black-Scholes Policy for NGLab.

Implements a trading strategy based on the Black-Scholes option pricing model, buying or selling based on deviations from the theoretical fair value.

class policies.black_scholes.BlackScholesPolicy(cfg=None)[source]¶

Bases: Policy

Policy based on Black-Scholes option pricing model. Decides to buy or sell based on the theoretical price vs market price.

act(observation)[source]¶

Determine action based on Black-Scholes fair value.

policies.neural module¶

Neural Network Policy for NGLab.

Wraps PyTorch or TorchRL modules to provide a consistent ‘act’ interface for model-based trading strategies.

class policies.neural.NeuralPolicy(model, cfg=None)[source]¶

Bases: Policy

Policy that wraps a PyTorch/TorchRL module.

Execute the model forward pass and extract an action.

Returns:

The predicted action.

Any

policies.regular module¶

Periodic (Regular) Policy for NGLab.

Executes a specific action at fixed intervals (e.g., rebalancing).

class policies.regular.RegularPolicy(cfg=None)[source]¶

Bases: Policy

Regular policy that executes an action every N steps. Ported conceptually from logic/src/policies/regular.py (which was bin collection based). Here adapted for trading: e.g. Rebalance every N days.

act(observation)[source]¶

Trigger action every ‘period’ steps.

reset()[source]¶

Reset the step counter.

policies.threshold module¶

Threshold-based Policy for NGLab.

Simple rule-based strategy that buys/sells based on fixed price thresholds.

class policies.threshold.ThresholdPolicy(cfg=None)[source]¶

Bases: Policy

Simple threshold-based policy. Buy if price < buy_threshold. Sell if price > sell_threshold.

act(observation)[source]¶

Determine action based on price relative to thresholds.
